sources.title: I created a simple Flux.2 Klein Raster to Vector Image (With Prompt ...
sources.snippet: This is a very simple, beginner-friendly, fast ComfyUI workflow based on Flux.2 Klein model (4B or 9B) that can first generate an usual Raster Image file (.jpg or .png or .webp) text-to- image output then right after that it converts it again to Vector Image file (.svg) output on the fly.
